text.aria-label: Title text 'F4 minus M* and F4 minus F4-R, by Primary and fold'

g.text: F4 minus M* and F4 minus F4-R, by Primary and fold

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Orange: F4 forecasts worse. Blue: F4 forecasts better. White: no difference. Rows 1 to 6: the six signed-MW Primaries (D5, D9, D10, D11, D14, D16); rows 7 to 14: the eight MVA-only Primaries. CRPS difference in points of capacity; below zero means F4 forecasts better. Each cell: one Primary's mean CRPS difference in one fold (one month; the 8 folds are November 2025 to June 2026), for the forecast averaged over 2 seeds, on leads of 24 h up to but not including 240 h. F4: neural network with neighbour rows. M*: the baseline of experiment 713, without neighbour rows. F4-R: F4 with its neighbours rewired to other Primaries (a placebo).'
text.tspan: Orange: F4 forecasts worse. Blue: F4 forecasts better. White: no difference.
Rows 1 to 6: the six signed-MW Primaries (D5, D9, D10, D11, D14, D16);
rows 7 to 14: the eight MVA-only Primaries.
CRPS difference in points of capacity; below zero means F4 forecasts better.
Each cell: one Primary's mean CRPS difference in one fold (one month; the 8 folds are
November 2025 to June 2026), for the forecast averaged over 2 seeds, on leads of 24 h
up to but not including 240 h.
F4: neural network with neighbour rows.
M*: the baseline of experiment 713, without neighbour rows.
F4-R: F4 with its neighbours rewired to other Primaries (a placebo).
